title: CAISO: batteries and the evening peak
subtitle: Mean by hour of the day, 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-28; battery output below zero is charging
source_line: Source: CAISO, EIA via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables caiso_battery_storage, eia930_all_demand; data retrieved to 2026-11-05.
citations: California ISO (CAISO). Today's Outlook: batteries trend (storage.csv history). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `caiso_battery_storage`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.

U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). Form EIA-930, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor: hourly demand, day-ahead demand forecast, net generation and interchange by balancing authority. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `eia930_all_demand`, ERW commit e2794ff06139.
facts: CAISO, 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-28: mean demand peaked in the hour starting 10:00 Pacific at 27365.14 MW, when batteries delivered a mean -7667.76 MW; batteries delivered the most in the hour starting 18:00, 7923.68 MW, and charged hardest in the hour starting 12:00, -8877.37 MW.
Mean battery output 17:00 to 21:00 Pacific, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-27: 5925.14 MW.
